title: Cylinder
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero and the translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0167, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.0167, 0.0) and ends at (0.0167, 0.0167). The third line starts at (0.0167, 0.0167) and ends at (0.0, 0.0167). The fourth line completes the loop by starting at (0.0, 0.0167) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scale factor of 0.0167 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. The resulting shape is a cylinder with a small protrusion at the top, measuring 0.0167 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0167, 0).lineTo(0.0167, 0.0167).lineTo(0, 0.0167).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = cylinder

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the top face (square with rounded corners)
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0024) \
     .threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0007), (0.0024, 0.0)) \
     .lineTo(0.0143, 0.0) \
     .threePointArc((0.0160, 0.0007), (0.0167, 0.0024)) \
     .lineTo(0.0167, 0.0143) \
     .threePointArc((0.0160, 0.0160), (0.0143, 0.0167)) \
     .lineTo(0.0024, 0.0167) \
     .threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0160), (0.0, 0.0143)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0024) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
r = r.extrude(0.75)
